source_title: Copper nanoparticles coated by reducing agent
source_abstract: Provided are copper nanoparticles that: (I) have excellent dispersibility in an organic solvent and thus makes a paste containing the copper nanoparticles from which a highly smooth coating film can be formed; and (II) have excellent sinterability at low temperatures. At least a portion of the surface layer of each of the copper nanoparticles coated by a reducing agent is a film that contains copper oxide and optionally contains copper carbonate. The surfaces of the copper nanoparticles are coated with a reducing agent, where the mass carbon concentration is 0.10% to 2.00%.
zh_title: 由还原剂包覆的铜纳米颗粒
zh_abstract: 提供了如下铜纳米颗粒：(I) 在有机溶剂中具有优异的分散性，因此可制备含有所述铜纳米颗粒的浆料，由该浆料能够形成高平滑性的涂膜；并且 (II) 在低温下具有优异的烧结性。由还原剂包覆的各铜纳米颗粒的表面层的至少一部分为含有氧化铜并任选含有碳酸铜的膜。所述铜纳米颗粒的表面包覆有还原剂，其中质量碳浓度为0.10% to 2.00%。

source_title: Laboratory scale fluid catalytic cracking unit for co-refining bio-based feedstocks
source_abstract: The invention relates to a test unit, particularly for the study of catalysts in reactions involving at least one catalyst and at least one reagent, such as fluid catalytic cracking reactions. The test unit comprises a downer, separator, riser, catalyst regenerator, and optional catalyst buffer. Transport of the catalyst is performed by screw conveyors.
zh_title: 用于共炼生物基原料的实验室规模流化催化裂化装置
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种测试装置，特别用于研究涉及至少一种催化剂和至少一种反应物的反应中的催化剂，例如流化催化裂化反应。该测试装置包括下行管、分离器、提升管、催化剂再生器以及可选的催化剂缓冲器。催化剂的输送通过螺旋输送机进行。

source_title: Polymer composition for laser marking
source_abstract: The invention relates to a polymer composition containing a polyamide- or polyester-carrier polymer matrix into which special polymer particles are embedded, to a method for producing the polymer composition, to its use as a laser marking additive or laser welding additive in organic polymer compositions, and to a laser-markable or laser-weldable organic polymer composition containing the polymer composition.
zh_title: 用于激光标记的聚合物组合物
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种聚合物组合物，其含有聚酰胺或聚酯载体聚合物基质，特殊聚合物颗粒嵌入该基质中；还涉及该聚合物组合物的制备方法、其作为有机聚合物组合物中的激光标记添加剂或激光焊接添加剂的用途，以及含有该聚合物组合物的可激光标记或可激光焊接的有机聚合物组合物。

source_title: Medicinal agent (embodiments) and device for using same
source_abstract: The inventions are intended for stopping or slowing the progression of the acute phase of ischemic stroke, coronary failure and respiratory failure, and for saving injured and wounded persons suffering from heavy blood loss. A medicinal agent according to a first embodiment contains from 40 to 50 vol% helium, from 25 to 35 vol% argon, from 0.2 to 5 vol% xenon, from 2 to 10 vol% krypton, and not less than 21 vol% oxygen, to a total of 100 vol%, and the temperature of the gas mixture is 30-70°С. A medicinal agent according to a second embodiment contains from 21 to 60 vol% oxygen, from 0.2 to 35 vol% xenon, from 0.2 to 35 vol% krypton, or from 21 to 60 vol% oxygen, xenon in a concentration range of from 0.2 to 35 vol%, from 0.2 to 35 vol% krypton, and the remainder argon in an amount of not less 25 vol%, and the temperature of the gas is 15-70°С. The claimed device is characterized by a mask 1 connected to a breathing bag 7 and to a canister 12 containing an argon-xenon-krypton gas mixture, with a three-way valve for alternately supplying gases to the breathing bag 7, the device being further equipped with a canister 9 containing a helium-oxygen-argon-xenon-krypton gas mixture and having a valve mounted thereon with a manometer that is connected to the mask to permit a supply of the gas mixture directly into the mask 1, and a chemical or electric heater 11 with a connecting heat exchange line.
zh_title: 药剂（实施方案）及其使用装置
zh_abstract: 这些发明旨在阻止或减缓缺血性卒中急性期、冠状动脉功能不全和呼吸衰竭的进展，并用于抢救遭受大量失血的受伤和负伤人员。根据第一实施方案的药剂含有 40 至 50 vol% helium、25 至 35 vol% argon、0.2 至 5 vol% xenon、2 至 10 vol% krypton，以及不少于 21 vol% oxygen，总量为 100 vol%，且该气体混合物的温度为 30-70°С。根据第二实施方案的药剂含有 21 至 60 vol% oxygen、0.2 至 35 vol% xenon、0.2 至 35 vol% krypton，或者含有 21 至 60 vol% oxygen、浓度范围为 0.2 至 35 vol% 的 xenon、0.2 至 35 vol% krypton，余量为不少于 25 vol% 的 argon，且该气体的温度为 15-70°С。所要求保护的装置的特征在于，面罩 1 连接至呼吸袋 7 以及装有 argon-xenon-krypton 气体混合物的气瓶 12，并设有用于向呼吸袋 7 交替供应气体的三通阀；该装置还配备有装有 helium-oxygen-argon-xenon-krypton 气体混合物的气瓶 9，其上安装有带压力表的阀门，该阀门连接至面罩，以允许将该气体混合物直接供应到面罩 1 中；以及化学或电加热器 11，其带有连接的热交换管线。

source_title: Method for applying a coating to items made from valve metal and alloy thereof
source_abstract: The invention relates to the field of electrochemical application of coatings to the valve metals aluminium, titanium, magnesium and their alloys by the process of microarc oxidation (MAO) for a wide range of use not only on new items but also on post-operation items, in particular for restoring coatings after wear. A method includes submersion of an item in a bath with an aqueous electrolyte solution and MAO in a pulse anode-cathode mode. The MAO is performed by controlling the rate of growth of the coating at edges, corners and the centre of the item by changing the mode in the process of application of the coating using a device in which a charge unit includes a controllable pulse-increasing quasi-resonance converter with a current and voltage operating mode. The invention makes it possible to control the rate of production of the coating in different surface regions of an item, which makes it possible to obtain uniform coatings on the item in terms of thickness or a necessary thickness in regions thereof.
zh_title: 用于向由阀金属及其合金制成的物品施加涂层的方法
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及通过微弧氧化 (MAO) 工艺在阀金属 aluminium、titanium、magnesium 及其合金上电化学施加涂层的领域，其用途广泛，不仅适用于新物品，也适用于使用后的物品，特别是用于在磨损后修复涂层。一种方法包括将物品浸入含水电解质溶液的浴槽中，并在脉冲阳极-阴极模式下进行 MAO。通过使用一种装置，在施加涂层的过程中改变模式，以控制物品边缘、角部和中心处涂层的生长速率来进行 MAO；在该装置中，充电单元包括具有电流和电压工作模式的可控脉冲升压准谐振转换器。本发明能够控制物品不同表面区域中涂层的形成速率，从而能够在物品上获得厚度均匀的涂层，或在其各区域中获得所需厚度的涂层。

source_title: Methods for treating breast cancer
source_abstract: The present disclosure is directed to methods of treating breast cancer in a subject in need thereof comprising administering to said subject a therapeutically effective amount of a radiopharmaceutical compound with GRPR antagonist moiety, e.g. [<sup>177</sup>Lu]Lu-NeoB, in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor, e.g. ribocicilib, and with a therapeutically effective amount of an endocrine treatment, e.g. fulvestrant.
zh_title: 治疗乳腺癌的方法
zh_abstract: 本公开涉及治疗有需要的受试者的乳腺癌的方法，包括向所述受试者施用治疗有效量的具有 GRPR antagonist moiety 的放射性药物化合物，例如 [<sup>177</sup>Lu]Lu-NeoB，并联合 CDK4/6 抑制剂，例如 ribocicilib，以及治疗有效量的内分泌治疗，例如 fulvestrant。

source_title: Method for predicting response to a cancer treatment
source_abstract: The invention relates to a method for predicting the response to an anti-cancer treatment of patients suffering from cancer, said method being based on the detection of biomarkers. The invention also relates to methods of treatment and methods for selecting a cancer patient to be treated or methods for selecting a suitable therapy for a cancer patient based on the detection of said biomarkers.
zh_title: 预测对癌症治疗的响应的方法
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种预测患有癌症的患者对抗癌治疗的响应的方法，所述方法基于对生物标志物的检测。本发明还涉及基于对所述生物标志物的检测来选择待治疗的癌症患者的方法，或为癌症患者选择合适疗法的方法，以及治疗方法。

source_title: Method for elimination of pharmaceuticals from wastewater
source_abstract: Method for eliminatoin of pharmaceuticals from wastewater by biological, photo-oxidation and sorption means consists of eliminating the pharmaceuticals from 5000 parts by weight of water at 25 °C by biologically eliminating the pharmaceuticals by adding 300 to 800 parts by weight of a filling containing Pseudomonas fluorescens bacteria encapsulated in polyvinyl alcohol lenses. The resulting mixture is maintained in buoyancy by agitation for 24 to 500 hours, then biologically pretreated water is homogenized for 3 to 7 minutes. Then the pharmaceuticals are eliminated by photooxidation for 5 to 60 minutes by UV radiation with a relative radiant power of 50 W/L of treated water from and the addition of 0.4 to 0.6 parts by weight of 30% H2O2and then by sorption by adding 45 to 55 parts by weight of a sorbent, which is iron humate or zinc humate, and applying it with agitation for 30 to 240 minutes.
zh_title: 从废水中去除药物的方法
zh_abstract: 一种通过生物、光氧化和吸附手段从废水中去除药物的方法，包括在 25 °C 下从 5000 parts by weight 的水中去除药物：通过加入 300 to 800 parts by weight 的填料对药物进行生物去除，所述填料含有包埋在 polyvinyl alcohol lenses 中的 Pseudomonas fluorescens 细菌。所得混合物通过搅拌保持悬浮 24 to 500 hours，随后将经生物预处理的水均质 3 to 7 minutes。然后通过光氧化去除药物，采用相对辐射功率为 50 W/L 的 UV radiation 对处理水照射 5 to 60 minutes，并加入 0.4 to 0.6 parts by weight 的 30% H2O2，随后通过吸附去除药物，即加入 45 to 55 parts by weight 的吸附剂，所述吸附剂为 iron humate 或 zinc humate，并在搅拌下作用 30 to 240 minutes。

source_title: Polyether polymer, polyether electrolyte for lithium ion secondary battery, composite solid electrolyte for lithium ion secondary battery, and lithium ion secondary battery
source_abstract: The present invention provides: a polyether polymer capable of suppressing a side reaction with a sulfide-based solid electrolyte, and having a high ion transference number; a polyether electrolyte for a lithium ion secondary battery using the polyether polymer; a composite solid electrolyte for a lithium ion secondary battery; and a lithium ion secondary battery. The present invention relates to a polyether polymer including 20 mol% or more of an X unit, which is a constituent unit derived from a specific trimethylene oxide, in 100 mol% of constituent units.
zh_title: 聚醚聚合物、用于锂离子二次电池的聚醚电解质、用于锂离子二次电池的复合固体电解质以及锂离子二次电池
zh_abstract: 本发明提供：一种能够抑制与硫化物基固体电解质发生副反应且具有高离子迁移数的聚醚聚合物；使用该聚醚聚合物的用于锂离子二次电池的聚醚电解质；用于锂离子二次电池的复合固体电解质；以及锂离子二次电池。本发明涉及一种聚醚聚合物，其在 100 mol% 的构成单元中包含 20 mol% 或更多的 X单元，所述 X单元是衍生自特定 trimethylene oxide 的构成单元。

source_title: Methods for increasing transfer cell density in seed culture and realizing high cell density inoculation in production cultures
source_abstract: The present application discloses methods for increasing transfer cell density in seed cultures and realizing high cell density inoculation in production cultures. The method for increasing the transfer cell density of a culture comprises cultivating cells by perfusion in a seed culture; and subjecting the seed culture to concentration by perfusion.
zh_title: 提高种子培养中的转移细胞密度并在生产培养中实现高细胞密度接种的方法
zh_abstract: 本申请公开了提高种子培养中的转移细胞密度并在生产培养中实现高细胞密度接种的方法。提高培养物转移细胞密度的方法包括：在种子培养中通过灌流培养细胞；以及通过灌流对种子培养物进行浓缩。

source_title: LABELED COLLAGEN IVα1 PROTEIN, LABELED COLLAGEN IVα2 PROTEIN, NUCLEIC ACIDS ENCODING SAID PROTEINS, AND ANIMALS HAVING SAID NUCLEIC ACIDS
source_abstract: The present disclosure relates to: a labeled collagen IVα1 protein; a labeled collagen IVα2 protein; nucleic acids encoding said proteins; and animals having said nucleic acids. The present disclosure also relates to a method for observing the labeled collagen IVα1 protein or the labeled collagen IVα2 protein in the animals.
zh_title: 标记的 collagen IVα1 蛋白、标记的 collagen IVα2 蛋白、编码所述蛋白的核酸以及具有所述核酸的动物
zh_abstract: 本公开涉及：标记的 collagen IVα1 蛋白；标记的 collagen IVα2 蛋白；编码所述蛋白的核酸；以及具有所述核酸的动物。本公开还涉及一种在所述动物中观察标记的 collagen IVα1 蛋白或标记的 collagen IVα2 蛋白的方法。

source_title: Multifunctional device, device holder, kit, use of bioactive factors isolated and purified from colostrum, method for preparing enriched autologous platelet concentrates
source_abstract: The present invention relates to a multifunctional device (1) for collecting a biological fluid, for example whole blood, comprising: a tubular container (2) delimiting an open container end (3), a cap (5), wherein the cap (5) is fluid-tightly connected to the tubular container (2), closing the open container end (3) so that the tubular container (2) and the cap (5) enclose a collection chamber (4) configured to be depressurized and/or filled with the biological fluid, wherein the cap (5) comprises: a cap body (6) connected to the tubular fluid-tight container (2), a reversible access device (7), wherein the reversible access device (7) is fluid-tightly connected to the cap body (6), wherein the reversible access device (7) is configured to allow a reversible fluid-tight access to the collection chamber (4) without separating the cap (5) from the tubular container (2) to depressurize the collection chamber and/or collect the biological fluid in the collection chamber (4) and/or extract the biological fluid from the collection chamber (4), the cap (5) comprising at least one reservoir (8, 8') fluid-tightly connected to the cap body (6), wherein each reservoir (8, 8') delimits a respective containment chamber (9) configured to contain at least one mixing substance, wherein each reservoir (8, 8') is in a closed configuration in which the respective containment chamber (9) is fluidly isolated from the collection chamber (4), wherein each reservoir (8, 8') is configured to be operated and opened on command, switching from the closed configuration to an open configuration in which the respective containment chamber (9) is open and in communication with the collection chamber (4) keeping the cap (5) fluid-tightly connected to the tubular container (2).
zh_title: 多功能装置、装置保持器、套件、从初乳中分离和纯化的生物活性因子的用途、制备富集的自体血小板浓缩物的方法
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种用于收集生物流体例如全血的多功能装置 (1)，其包括：管状容器 (2)，限定容器开口端 (3)；盖 (5)，其中盖 (5) 以液密方式连接至管状容器 (2)，封闭容器开口端 (3)，使得管状容器 (2) 和盖 (5) 围成收集腔 (4)，所述收集腔被配置为可减压和/或填充生物流体，其中盖 (5) 包括：连接至管状液密容器 (2) 的盖体 (6)；可逆接入装置 (7)，其中可逆接入装置 (7) 以液密方式连接至盖体 (6)，其中可逆接入装置 (7) 被配置为在不将盖 (5) 与管状容器 (2) 分离的情况下，允许对收集腔 (4) 进行可逆的液密接入，以使收集腔减压和/或在收集腔 (4) 中收集生物流体和/或从收集腔 (4) 中提取生物流体；盖 (5) 包括至少一个以液密方式连接至盖体 (6) 的贮存器 (8, 8')，其中每个贮存器 (8, 8') 限定相应的容纳腔 (9)，所述容纳腔被配置为容纳至少一种混合物质，其中每个贮存器 (8, 8') 处于关闭构型，在该构型中相应的容纳腔 (9) 与收集腔 (4) 流体隔离，其中每个贮存器 (8, 8') 被配置为可按指令操作并打开，从关闭构型切换至打开构型，在该打开构型中，相应的容纳腔 (9) 打开并与收集腔 (4) 连通，同时保持盖 (5) 以液密方式连接至管状容器 (2)。

source_title: Amino compound-containing dispersion powder compositions
source_abstract: The invention relates to water-redispersible dispersion powder compositions (dispersion powder compositions) based on copolymers of a) vinyl acetate, b) ethylene, c) optionally one or more auxiliary monomers, and d) optionally one or more additional ethylenically unsaturated monomers. The invention is characterized in that one or more amino compounds (nitrogen compounds) selected from the group comprising polyoxyalkylene amines, polyethylene imines, aliphatic polyamines, and compounds of the formula R-NR'H are contained, wherein in the formula R-NR'H, the group R represents a linear or branched and optionally substituted hydrocarbon group with 1 to 20 carbon atoms and R' is a hydrogen atom, an NH 2 group, or a carbonyl group, with the proviso that the auxiliary monomers c) are selected from the group comprising ethylenically unsaturated mono- and dicarboxylic acids, ethylenically unsaturated carboxylic acid nitriles, acrylamide (CH 2 CHCONH 2 ), ethylenically unsaturated sulfonic acids, ethylenically unsaturated silicon-functional monomers, and hydroxyethyl, hydroxypropyl, or hydroxybutyl acrylate or methacrylate; the additional ethylenically unsaturated monomers d) are selected from the group comprising methyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, ethyl acrylate, ethyl methacrylate, propyl acrylate, propyl methacrylate, n-butyl acrylate, n-butyl methacrylate, 2-ethylhexyl acrylate, norbornyl acrylate, vinyl aromatics, and vinyl halides; and the water-redispersible dispersion powder compositions do not contain epoxide group-containing compounds (epoxide compounds).
zh_title: 含氨基化合物的分散粉末组合物
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及水可再分散的分散粉末组合物（分散粉末组合物），其基于 a) vinyl acetate、b) ethylene、c) 任选的一种或多种辅助单体，以及 d) 任选的一种或多种其他烯键式不饱和单体的共聚物。本发明的特征在于，含有一种或多种选自包括 polyoxyalkylene amines、polyethylene imines、aliphatic polyamines 以及式 R-NR'H 的化合物的组中的氨基化合物（氮化合物），其中，在式 R-NR'H 中，基团 R 表示具有 1 to 20 个碳原子的直链或支链且任选取代的烃基，R' 为氢原子、NH 2 基团或羰基，条件是辅助单体 c) 选自包括烯键式不饱和单羧酸和二羧酸、烯键式不饱和羧酸腈、acrylamide (CH 2 CHCONH 2 )、烯键式不饱和磺酸、烯键式不饱和硅官能单体，以及 hydroxyethyl、hydroxypropyl 或 hydroxybutyl acrylate 或 methacrylate 的组；其他烯键式不饱和单体 d) 选自包括 methyl acrylate、methyl methacrylate、ethyl acrylate、ethyl methacrylate、propyl acrylate、propyl methacrylate、n-butyl acrylate、n-butyl methacrylate、2-ethylhexyl acrylate、norbornyl acrylate、vinyl aromatics 和 vinyl halides 的组；并且所述水可再分散的分散粉末组合物不含 epoxide group-containing compounds (epoxide compounds)。

source_title: Process for the production of (1r,2s)-2,6-dimethyl-1-indanamine using dynamic kinetic stereoisomer resolution
source_abstract: Described is a process for producing nearly enantiomerically pure (1R,2S)-2,6-dimethyl-1-indanamine, said process being characterized by the reaction of a mixture of the four stereoisomers of 2,6-dimethyl-1-indanamine with an acylating or carboxylating agent in the presence of a protein with lipase activity and being carried out using dynamic kinetic stereoisomer resolution.
zh_title: 使用动态动力学立体异构体拆分生产(1r,2s)-2,6-dimethyl-1-indanamine的方法
zh_abstract: 描述了一种生产近乎对映体纯的(1R,2S)-2,6-dimethyl-1-indanamine的方法，所述方法的特征在于，使2,6-dimethyl-1-indanamine的四种立体异构体的混合物在具有脂肪酶活性的蛋白质存在下与酰化剂或羧化剂反应，并使用动态动力学立体异构体拆分进行。

source_title: Semi-permanent smoothing hair composition and uses thereof
source_abstract: Provided herein are catalyst cream base compositions and activator compositions, kits comprising the same and methods of use thereof. The catalyst cream base composition can comprise calcium hydroxide and a silicone blocker and the activator compositions can comprise guanidine hydrochloride. The compositions can be used for the preparation of smoothing compositions. The methods of use can comprise methods of semi-permanently smoothing hair. The kits can comprise catalyst cream base compositions and activator compositions and instructions to use the same for semi-permanently smoothing hair.
zh_title: 半永久性顺滑头发组合物及其用途
zh_abstract: 本文提供催化剂乳膏基质组合物和活化剂组合物、包含其的套件及其使用方法。所述催化剂乳膏基质组合物可包含calcium hydroxide和silicone blocker，所述活化剂组合物可包含guanidine hydrochloride。所述组合物可用于制备顺滑组合物。所述使用方法可包括半永久性顺滑头发的方法。所述套件可包含催化剂乳膏基质组合物和活化剂组合物，以及使用其进行半永久性顺滑头发的说明。

source_title: Low temperature curing composition for rubber based adhesives and sealants
source_abstract: The invention relates to a rubber-based composition that can be thermally cured at reduced temperature while retaining performance over a broad cure temperature window comprising at least one solid rubber, at least one diene-based polymer or copolymer containing an olefinic double bond and/or an aromatically substituted olefin, suitable for undergoing curing with a curing system present as quinone dioxime, peroxides and optional multifunctional acrylates, preferably in the absence of elemental sulfur. The cured composition exhibits improved reversion resistance and adhesion strength on aluminum.
zh_title: 用于橡胶基粘合剂和密封剂的低温固化组合物
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种橡胶基组合物，其可在降低的温度下热固化，同时在较宽的固化温度窗口内保持性能；该组合物包含至少一种固体橡胶、至少一种含有烯属双键和/或芳香取代烯烃的二烯基聚合物或共聚物，适合通过以quinone dioxime、过氧化物和可选的多官能丙烯酸酯形式存在的固化体系进行固化，优选在不存在元素硫的情况下进行。固化后的组合物在铝上的抗返原性和粘附强度得到改善。

source_title: Biodegradable, industrially compostable, and recyclable injection molded microcellular flexible foams
source_abstract: This document discloses a process for manufacturing recyclable injection molded microcellular foams for use in, footwear components, seating components, protective gear components, and watersport accessories. The process includes the steps of providing a thermoplastic polymer which comprises at least one monomer derived from depolymerized post-consumer plastic, inserting a fluid into a barrel of a molding apparatus. The fluid is introduced under temperature and pressure conditions to produce a super critical fluid. The process further includes mixing the thermoplastic polymer and super critical fluid so as to create a single phase solution, and injecting the single phase solution into a mold of an injection molding machine under gas counter pressure. The process further includes foaming the single phase solution by controlling the head and temperature conditions within the mold.
zh_title: 可生物降解、可工业堆肥且可回收的注塑成型微孔柔性泡沫
zh_abstract: 本文公开了一种用于制造可回收注塑成型微孔泡沫的工艺，所述泡沫可用于鞋类部件、座椅部件、防护装备部件和水上运动配件。该工艺包括以下步骤：提供一种热塑性聚合物，其包含至少一种来源于解聚的消费后塑料的单体；将流体引入成型设备的机筒中。该流体在温度和压力条件下被引入，以产生超临界流体。该工艺还包括将所述热塑性聚合物与超临界流体混合，以形成单相溶液，并在气体反压下将该单相溶液注入注塑机的模具中。该工艺还包括通过控制模具内的 head 和温度条件使该单相溶液发泡。

source_title: Ferritic stainless steel for ammonia combustion environment
source_abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a ferritic stainless steel for an NH3 combustion environment and having excellent high-temperature NH3 resistance in an NH3 combustion environment in which high-temperature NH3 is included. This ferritic stainless steel for an NH3 combustion environment has a component composition which contains, in mass%, 0.020% or less of C, 0.05-2.50% of Si, 0.05-2.00% of Mn, 0.050% or less of P, 0.010% or less of S, 0.20-6.00% of Al, 0.020% or less of N, and 12.0-25.0% of Cr, and in which the remaining portion includes Fe and unavoidable impurities.
zh_title: 用于氨燃烧环境的铁素体不锈钢
zh_abstract: 本发明的目的在于提供一种用于NH3燃烧环境的铁素体不锈钢，其在包含高温NH3的NH3燃烧环境中具有优异的高温NH3耐受性。该用于NH3燃烧环境的铁素体不锈钢具有如下成分组成：以mass%计，含有0.020% or less的C、0.05-2.50%的Si、0.05-2.00%的Mn、0.050% or less的P、0.010% or less的S、0.20-6.00%的Al、0.020% or less的N以及12.0-25.0%的Cr，余量包括Fe和不可避免的杂质。

source_title: A solid dispersion of enzalutamide
source_abstract: The present invention relates to a solid dispersion comprising enzalutamide or its pharmaceutically acceptable salts, hydroxypropyl methylcellulose phthalate (HPMCP), soluplus® (polyvinyl caprolactam-polyvinyl acetate-polyethylene glycol), surfactant, and optionally at least one pharmaceutically acceptable excipient. The present invention also relates to a pharmaceutical composition comprising the solid dispersion of enzalutamide and its use for treating prostate cancer. The present invention further relates to a process for preparation of the solid dispersion of enzalutamide and the pharmaceutical composition comprising the solid dispersion of enzalutamide.
zh_title: enzalutamide的固体分散体
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种固体分散体，其包含enzalutamide或其药学上可接受的盐、hydroxypropyl methylcellulose phthalate (HPMCP)、soluplus® (polyvinyl caprolactam-polyvinyl acetate-polyethylene glycol)、表面活性剂，以及任选的至少一种药学上可接受的辅料。本发明还涉及一种包含enzalutamide的固体分散体的药物组合物及其在治疗前列腺癌中的用途。本发明进一步涉及一种制备enzalutamide的固体分散体以及包含enzalutamide的固体分散体的药物组合物的方法。

source_title: Shaped body and method for a photovoltaic module
source_abstract: The invention relates to a shaped body (6, 7) for producing a photovoltaic module, in particular a thermal photovoltaic module (4), comprising: - an upper face (11) which is concavely or convexly curved in a height direction (Z) in order to bend a layer stack (12) comprising at least two layers (1, 2, 3) for the photovoltaic module (4). The invention also relates to a method for processing a layer stack (12) for a photovoltaic module.
zh_title: 用于光伏组件的成型体和方法
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种用于制造光伏组件、特别是热光伏组件(4)的成型体(6, 7)，其包括：- 上表面(11)，该上表面在高度方向(Z)上呈凹形或凸形弯曲，以弯曲包括至少两层(1, 2, 3)的用于光伏组件(4)的层叠体(12)。本发明还涉及一种用于处理光伏组件的层叠体(12)的方法。

source_title: Process for producing fuel, base oils, and/or chemicals from renewable feedstocks
source_abstract: A renewable feedstock is pretreated and then hydrotreated to produce an effluent. The effluent is separated into a liquid stream and an offgas stream. At least one of the offgas streams comprises hydrogen sulphide. The offgas stream is passed to a biological desulfurization unit where a majority of the hydrogen sulphide is converted to bio-sulphur. At least a portion of the bio-sulphur is recycled to the pretreating step.
zh_title: 由可再生原料生产燃料、基础油和/或化学品的方法
zh_abstract: 对可再生原料进行预处理，然后进行加氢处理以产生流出物。将该流出物分离为液体流和尾气流。至少一个尾气流包含hydrogen sulphide。将该尾气流送至生物脱硫单元，在其中大部分hydrogen sulphide被转化为bio-sulphur。至少一部分bio-sulphur被循环至预处理步骤。

source_title: Plant microbes and uses thereof
source_abstract: Provided herein are compositions and methods for use in challenging pathogenic bacteria on plants. Optional features include modification of a donor bacteria to include exogenous nucleic acids encoding for conjugation machinery and gene modification components, such as guide sequence for use in CRISPR. The compositions and methods provided herein can be used for delivery to a wide variety of crops and for targeting one or more pathogens.
zh_title: 植物微生物及其用途
zh_abstract: 本文提供了用于对抗植物上病原性细菌的组合物和方法。可选特征包括对供体细菌进行修饰，使其包含编码接合机制和基因修饰组分的外源核酸，例如用于 CRISPR 的引导序列。本文提供的组合物和方法可用于递送至多种作物，并用于靶向一种或多种病原体。

source_title: Recycling of glass-containing pvb wastes via high temperature treatment
source_abstract: It has been discovered that high volumes of glass particles and valuable recycled content products may be directly derived from waste PVB-containing compositions, such as interlayers. More particularly, one or more valuable recycled content products and glass particles can be consistently recovered from the high temperature treatment of waste PVB-containing compositions. Consequently, one can optimize recovery and utilization of recycled content products from waste PVB-containing compositions.
zh_title: 通过高温处理回收含玻璃的 pvb 废料
zh_abstract: 已经发现，可从废弃的含 PVB 组合物（例如中间层）中直接获得大量玻璃颗粒和有价值的含再生成分产品。更具体地说，可以从废弃的含 PVB 组合物的高温处理中稳定回收一种或多种有价值的含再生成分产品和玻璃颗粒。因此，可以优化从废弃的含 PVB 组合物中回收和利用含再生成分产品的过程。

source_title: Conductive particles, conductive material, and connection structure
source_abstract: Provided are conductive particles capable of exhibiting low dielectric properties. These conductive particles comprise base material particles, and a conductive layer disposed on the surface of the base material particles. The base material particles are a polymer of polymerizable components. The polymerizable components include a polymerizable compound having one or more maleimide groups. Of the 100 wt% of the polymerizable components, the content of the polymerizable compound having one or more maleimide groups is 10 wt% or more and 80 wt% or less. The dielectric constant of the base material particles is 2.80 F/m or less, and the dielectric loss tangent of the base material particles is 0.01 or less.
zh_title: 导电粒子、导电材料和连接结构
zh_abstract: 提供能够表现出低介电特性的导电粒子。该导电粒子包含基材粒子以及设置在基材粒子表面上的导电层。基材粒子是可聚合组分的聚合物。可聚合组分包括具有一个或多个maleimide基团的可聚合化合物。在可聚合组分的100 wt%中，具有一个或多个maleimide基团的可聚合化合物的含量为10 wt%或更多且80 wt%或更少。基材粒子的介电常数为2.80 F/m或更低，并且基材粒子的介电损耗角正切为0.01或更低。

source_title: Chemical pretreatment method for metallic substrates including pre-rinse treatment step
source_abstract: The present invention relates to a method of chemical pretreatment of a metallic surface of a substrate comprising at least steps 1) and 2), i.e., contacting the metallic surface at least in portion with an aqueous pre-rinse composition PRC, which comprises at least zirconium cations and copper cations (step 1)), and contacting at least the pre-rinsed portion of the metallic surface obtained after step 1)) at least in portion with an aqueous composition AC, which comprises zirconium cations, copper cations, and at least one organosilane and/or at least one hydrolysis and/or condensation product thereof, a method of coating the surface of the substrate that has undergone the aforementioned chemical pretreatment method, a substrate obtainable by these methods, and a kit-of-parts comprising an aqueous pre-rinse composition PRC or a concentrate thereof, and an aqueous composition AC or a concentrate thereof.
zh_title: 用于金属基材的化学预处理方法，包括预冲洗处理步骤
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及一种对基材的金属表面进行化学预处理的方法，该方法包括至少步骤 1) 和 2)，即，使该金属表面至少部分地与水性预冲洗组合物 PRC 接触，所述水性预冲洗组合物 PRC 至少包含锆阳离子和铜阳离子（步骤 1)），并使步骤 1) 后获得的金属表面的至少经预冲洗部分至少部分地与水性组合物 AC 接触，所述水性组合物 AC 包含锆阳离子、铜阳离子以及至少一种有机硅烷和/或其至少一种水解和/或缩合产物；本发明还涉及一种对已经过上述化学预处理方法的基材表面进行涂覆的方法、可通过这些方法获得的基材，以及一种 kit-of-parts，其包含水性预冲洗组合物 PRC 或其浓缩物，以及水性组合物 AC 或其浓缩物。

source_title: Anhydrous cosmetic composition including oil and platy mineral, and methods of use
source_abstract: Method and composition for making up the lips. Method includes applying to the lips an anhydrous composition. The composition includes at least one nonvolatile silicone oil; at least one volatile oil; at least one film-former; at least one colorant; at least one platy mineral; and a mattifying agent. The at least one nonvolatile silicone oil and the at least one volatile oil are present in a weight ratio of nonvolatile silicone oil to volatile oil from about 4:1 to about 10:1.
zh_title: 包含油和片状矿物的无水化妆品组合物及其使用方法
zh_abstract: 用于唇部化妆的方法和组合物。该方法包括向唇部施用一种无水组合物。该组合物包含至少一种非挥发性硅油；至少一种挥发性油；至少一种成膜剂；至少一种着色剂；至少一种片状矿物；以及一种哑光剂。所述至少一种非挥发性硅油和所述至少一种挥发性油以非挥发性硅油与挥发性油的重量比为约 4:1 至约 10:1 存在。

source_title: Wick-based analytical device for multiplexed quantification of biomarkers using carbon dots integrated with molecularly imprinted polymer
source_abstract: A device for assaying analytes has a wicking substrate having a sample zone, a waste zone, a plurality of channels that each support capillary flow between the sample zone and the waste zone. The channels comprise different synthetic receptors that are selected to interact with different analytes. The channels also include nanoparticles that are configured to undergo a visible state change when an interaction between an analyte and a synthetic receptor occurs nearby. An extent of the state change along a channel is indicative of concentration of the analyte that corresponds to that channel.
zh_title: 基于芯吸的分析装置，用于使用与分子印迹聚合物集成的碳点对生物标志物进行多重定量
zh_abstract: 一种用于测定分析物的装置，其具有芯吸基底，该芯吸基底具有样品区、废液区以及多个通道，每个通道均支持样品区与废液区之间的毛细流动。所述通道包含不同的合成受体，所述合成受体被选择为与不同的分析物相互作用。所述通道还包括纳米颗粒，所述纳米颗粒被配置为当分析物与合成受体之间的相互作用在附近发生时产生可见的状态变化。沿通道的状态变化程度指示与该通道对应的分析物的浓度。

source_title: A process for preparing an electrode film and implementations thereof
source_abstract: The present disclosure provides a process for preparing an electrode fdm, the process comprising: first calendering through a first set of rollers (101) to obtain a first film and second calendering the first film through a second set of rollers (102) to obtain an electrode film, wherein the electrode film has a porosity in a range of 17 to 22% and a density in a range of 1.7 to 3.9 g/cc. The present disclosure further provides an electrode film obtained by the process as disclosed herein, an electrode comprising the electrode film as disclosed herein, a method of preparing the electrode as disclosed herein, a first electrochemical cell comprising the electrode as disclosed herein, and a use of the electrode film, electrode and electrochemical cell as disclosed herein.
zh_title: 一种制备电极膜的方法及其实施方式
zh_abstract: 本公开提供了一种制备电极膜的方法，所述方法包括：首先通过第一组辊 (101) 进行压延以获得第一膜，并使所述第一膜通过第二组辊 (102) 进行第二次压延以获得电极膜，其中所述电极膜的孔隙率在 17 to 22% 范围内，密度在 1.7 to 3.9 g/cc 范围内。本公开还提供了通过本文公开的方法获得的电极膜、包括本文公开的电极膜的电极、制备本文公开的电极的方法、包括本文公开的电极的第一电化学电池，以及本文公开的电极膜、电极和电化学电池的用途。

source_title: Aluminium casting alloy
source_abstract: The invention relates to the field of metallurgy, and more particularly to aluminium-based alloys, and can be used for producing complex-shaped thin-walled castings, preferably by die casting. An aluminium-based casting alloy contains: 2.0 – 5.2 wt% calcium; 0.05 – 0.8 wt% silicon; 0.05 – 1.0 wt% iron; 0.01 – 5.0 wt% zinc; 0.01 – 2.0 wt% magnesium; optionally, at least one alloying element from among the group: 0.01 – 1.4 wt% copper; 0.01 – 1.5 wt% manganese; 0.01 – 0.2 wt% chromium; 0.01 – 0.2 wt% titanium; 0.01 – 0.2 wt% zirconium, aluminium and unavoidable impurities. The technical result of the invention is that of providing high strength properties, while preserving plasticity, workability during casting, and high corrosion resistance.
zh_title: Aluminium铸造合金
zh_abstract: 本发明涉及冶金领域，更具体地涉及aluminium基合金，并可用于生产形状复杂的薄壁铸件，优选通过压铸生产。一种aluminium基铸造合金含有：2.0 – 5.2 wt% calcium；0.05 – 0.8 wt% silicon；0.05 – 1.0 wt% iron；0.01 – 5.0 wt% zinc；0.01 – 2.0 wt% magnesium；可选地，至少一种选自以下组的合金化元素：0.01 – 1.4 wt% copper；0.01 – 1.5 wt% manganese；0.01 – 0.2 wt% chromium；0.01 – 0.2 wt% titanium；0.01 – 0.2 wt% zirconium，aluminium和不可避免的杂质。本发明的技术效果在于提供高强度性能，同时保持塑性、铸造过程中的工艺性能以及高耐腐蚀性。

source_title: Aqueous dispersions of pre-crosslinked organopolysiloxanes
source_abstract: Described are novel aqueous dispersions of pre-crosslinked organopolysiloxanes which contain on average at least one structural unit of general formula (I): SiRO 2/2 -Y-SiRO 2/2 and units of formula (II): R 2 SiO 2/2 , wherein Y means a group of formula: -R 2 -[NR 3 -R 4 ] x -NR 3 -OC-[C(Z 1 )(H)] k1 -[C(Z 2 )(H)] k2 -CO-NR 3 -[R 4 -NR 3 ] a -R 2 -R 2 SiO 1/2 -[R 2 SiO 2/2 ] b -R 2 SiO 1/2 -R 2 -[NR 3 -R 4 ] a - NR 3 -OC-[C(Z 2 )(H)] k2 -[C(Z 1 )(H)] k1 -CO-NR 3 -[R 4 -NR 3 ] x -R 2 -, R can be the same or different, means a monovalent SiC-bound hydrocarbon group with 1 to 18 carbon atoms which can contain one or more heteroatoms from the group N, P, S, O and halogen, R 2 means an SiC-bound, divalent linear or branched hydrocarbon group with 3 to 18 carbon atoms, R 3 is a hydrogen atom, an alkyl group with 1 to 8 carbon atoms or an acyl group, R 4 means a divalent hydrocarbon group with 1 to 6 carbon atoms, k1 is 0, 1, 2 or 3, k2 is 0, 1, 2 or 3, x is 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4, a is 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4, b is 0 or an integer from 1 to 500, Z 1 means -OH, H or -NHR 3 and Z 2 means -OH, H or -NHR 3 .
zh_title: 预交联有机聚硅氧烷的水性分散体
zh_abstract: 描述了新型预交联有机聚硅氧烷水性分散体，其平均含有至少一个通式 (I) 的结构单元：SiRO 2/2 -Y-SiRO 2/2 以及式 (II) 的单元：R 2 SiO 2/2 ，其中 Y 表示下式的基团：-R 2 -[NR 3 -R 4 ] x -NR 3 -OC-[C(Z 1 )(H)] k1 -[C(Z 2 )(H)] k2 -CO-NR 3 -[R 4 -NR 3 ] a -R 2 -R 2 SiO 1/2 -[R 2 SiO 2/2 ] b -R 2 SiO 1/2 -R 2 -[NR 3 -R 4 ] a - NR 3 -OC-[C(Z 2 )(H)] k2 -[C(Z 1 )(H)] k1 -CO-NR 3 -[R 4 -NR 3 ] x -R 2 -，R 可以相同或不同，表示具有 1 to 18 个碳原子的单价 SiC 键合烃基，其可含有一个或多个来自 N, P, S, O 和卤素组的杂原子，R 2 表示具有 3 to 18 个碳原子的 SiC 键合二价直链或支链烃基，R 3 为氢原子、具有 1 to 8 个碳原子的烷基或酰基，R 4 表示具有 1 to 6 个碳原子的二价烃基，k1 为 0, 1, 2 或 3，k2 为 0, 1, 2 或 3，x 为 0, 1, 2, 3 或 4，a 为 0, 1, 2, 3 或 4，b 为 0 或 1 to 500 的整数，Z 1 表示 -OH、H 或 -NHR 3，且 Z 2 表示 -OH、H 或 -NHR 3。
